drivingQuestion: How may mustard kneaded before Shabbat be dissolved on Shabbat?
outcomeNote: Mar Zutra rules against all the stated views, following the anonymous dictum.

segments.he: לְפִי שֶׁאֵין עוֹשִׂין אוֹתָהּ אֶלָּא לְגָוֶון.
segments.en: «Because it is only made to» enhance the «color» of the food. That does not negate the egg-white as significant food in the sense that it would be considered waste, and therefore, no actual selection is performed.

segments.he: אִיתְּמַר. חַרְדָּל שֶׁלָּשׁוֹ מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, לְמָחָר, אָמַר רַב: מְמַחוֹ בִּכְלִי אֲבָל לֹא בַּיָּד.
segments.en: «It is stated:» With regard to «mustard that one kneaded on Shabbat eve, on the following day,» Shabbat, «Rav said: One may dissolve it» in wine or water «with a vessel, but not with» his «hand,» as using a vessel diverges from the normal method of preparation.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ שְׁמוּאֵל: (בַּיָּד?!) אַטּוּ כׇּל יוֹמָא בְּיָד מְמַחוּ לֵיהּ?! מַאֲכַל חֲמוֹרִים הוּא! אֶלָּא אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: מְמַחוֹ בַּיָּד וְאֵינוֹ מְמַחוֹ בִּכְלִי.
segments.en: «Shmuel said to him:» Why may he not dissolve it «with» his «hand? Is that to say that he dissolves it with» his «hand every day?» If it is prepared in that manner, «it is donkey food.» Certainly dissolving by hand is not the manner in which mustard is prepared during the week. Therefore, dissolving mustard with a vessel should not be permitted on Shabbat. «Rather, Shmuel said» the opposite: «He may dissolve it with» his «hand» as a divergence from the typical method of preparation, «but he may not dissolve it» in the usual manner, «with a vessel.»

segments.he: אִתְּמַר. רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אָמַר: אֶחָד זֶה וְאֶחָד זֶה — אָסוּר. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: אֶחָד זֶה וְאֶחָד זֶה — מוּתָּר. אַבָּיֵי וְרָבָא דְּאָמְרִי תַּרְוַיְיהוּ: אֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן.
segments.en: «It is stated» that amora’im from Eretz Yisrael also disputed this issue, as «Rabbi Elazar said: Both this and that,» dissolving by hand and with a vessel, «are prohibited;» while «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Both this and that are permitted. Abaye and Rava both said:» The «halakha is not in accordance with» the lenient opinion of «Rabbi Yoḥanan.»

segments.he: קָם רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בְּשִׁיטְתֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, קָם רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בְּשִׁיטְתֵיהּ דִּשְׁמוּאֵל. אַבָּיֵי וְרָבָא דְּאָמְרִי תַּרְוַיְיהוּ: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן.
segments.en: Subsequently, «Rabbi Yoḥanan stood» and adopted «the opinion» of «Rabbi Elazar» and prohibited both methods of dissolving. «Rabbi Elazar stood» and adopted «the opinion» of «Shmuel,» who prohibited using a vessel but permitted it by hand. Given these stances, «Abaye and Rava both said:» The «halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yoḥanan,» who prohibited both methods.

segments.he: אִימֵּיהּ דְּאַבָּיֵי עֲבַדָא לֵיהּ, וְלָא אֲכַל. דְּבֵיתְהוּ דִּזְעִירָא עֲבַדָא לֵיהּ לְרַב חִיָּיא בַּר אָשֵׁי, וְלָא אֲכַל. אֲמַרָה לֵיהּ: לְרַבָּךְ עֲבַדִי לֵיהּ וַאֲכַל, וְאַתְּ לָא אָכְלַתְּ? אָמַר רָבָא בַּר שְׁבָא: הֲוָה קָאֵימְנָא קַמֵּיהּ דְּרָבִינָא וּבְחַשִׁי לֵיהּ בְּשׁוּפְתָּא דְתוּמָא וַאֲכַל.
segments.en: The Gemara relates: «Abaye’s mother,» actually his foster mother, «prepared» mustard «for him, and he did not eat» it. «Ze’eira’s wife prepared» mustard «for Rav Ḥiyya bar Ashi,» her husband’s student, «and he did not eat» it. «She said to him: I made» this «for your rabbi and he ate» it, «and you do not eat» it? «Rava bar Shabba said: I was standing before Ravina, and they stirred» mustard «for him with the inner part of the garlic, and he ate» it.

segments.he: אָמַר מָר זוּטְרָא: לֵית הִלְכְתָא כְּכׇל הָנֵי שְׁמַעְתָּתָא, אֶלָּא כִּי הָא דְּאִתְּמַר: חַרְדָּל שֶׁלָּשׁוֹ מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, לְמָחָר מְמַחוֹ בֵּין בַּיָּד בֵּין בִּכְלִי וְנוֹתֵן לְתוֹכוֹ דְּבַשׁ. וְלֹא יִטְרוֹף, אֶלָּא מְעָרֵב.
segments.en: «Mar Zutra said: The halakha is not in accordance with any of these statements. Rather, it is in accordance with this» one, «as it was stated: Mustard that one kneaded on Shabbat eve, on the following day he may dissolve it either by hand or with a vessel, and he may place honey in it. And» when he dissolves it «he may not beat» it forcefully as would a craftsman, «but» he may «mix» it gently.

segments.he: שַׁחֲלַיִים שֶׁשְּׁחָקָן מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, לְמָחָר נוֹתֵן לְתוֹכָן שֶׁמֶן וָחוֹמֶץ, וּמַמְשִׁיךְ לְתוֹכָן אַמִּיתָא. וְלֹא יִטְרוֹף אֶלָּא מְעָרֵב. שׁוּם שֶׁרִיסְּקוֹ מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, לְמָחָר נוֹתֵן לְתוֹכוֹ פּוֹל וּגְרִיסִין, וְלֹא יִשְׁחוֹק אֶלָּא מְעָרֵב, וּמַמְשִׁיךְ אֶת אַמִּיתָא לְתוֹכָן. מַאי אַמִּיתָא? נִינְיָיא. אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ הַאי נִינְיָיא מְעַלְּיָא לְתַחְלֵי.
segments.en: «Cress that one ground on Shabbat eve, on the following day he may place oil and vinegar in it, and add amita into» the mixture, «and he may not beat» it, «but» he may «mix» it. Similarly, «garlic that one crushed on Shabbat eve, on the following day, he may place beans and grits in it, and he may not pound, but mix, and he may add amita into» the mixture. The Gemara asks: «What is amita?» The Gemara answers: It is «mint. Abaye said: Learn from this» that adding «mint is beneficial for cress.»
